name: gatra-native-engine
description: Native Big Data engine addon for Gatra's data<T> primitive — see BIGDATA_TYPE.md and src/runtime/native-bridge.js. Built automatically by the root package's `npm install` (scripts/build-native.js runs `cargo build --release` and renames the output — no Rust toolchain means it's silently skipped, Gatra runs fully on the pure-JS fallback). `npm run build` here is only for the alternate, per-platform-triple-named output `napi build` produces, useful if this ever needs publishing as a real multi-platform npm package.
